title: Tunisian White Beans Tagine
description: A rich and earthy stew made with dried white beans, featuring a velvety texture and deep flavors, reduced to be low-carb-friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soaked and drained white beans, chicken broth, and 1 cup of water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
Use an immersion blender to puree the beans to a velvety texture, or allow the stew to cool and puree it in a blender.
Return the stew to the pot and simmer over low heat for an additional 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, to reduce the liquid and thicken the stew.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve the tagine hot over low-carb accompaniments such as cauliflower rice or a side salad.
